request: Analyze GSE272213 for PMID 39144140 (Exercise-downregulated CD300E acted as a negative prognostic implication and tumor-promoted role in pan-cancer.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk mRNA-seq (paired-end TruSeq) of 4T1 subcutaneous mammary tumours
final.sample_inclusion: 5 exercise (E, 21 days voluntary wheel running) + 5 non-exercise (NE) tumour-bearing mice; tumours collected at day 21 (S2.2.p1, S3.1.p1)
final.primary_estimand: Effect of 21 days of voluntary wheel running on gene expression in 4T1 breast tumours: E vs NE (S2.2.p1, S3.1.p1, Figure 1B-D)
planned_contrasts: E vs NE in tumour tissue (S3.1.p1; paper: 22 DEGs; Cd300e down, 46% of NE, p = 0.008)
final.repeated_measure_unit: none; one tumour per animal, animals randomised into two independent groups (S2.2.p1). S3.1.p1 says 'five matched pairs' but no pairing variable exists and animals were randomised independently
final.normalization: HISAT2 -> StringTie FPKM; TMM normalisation for library size (S2.3.p1)
final.paper_method: TMM-normalised differential expression (tool not named; TMM implies edgeR); DEG = fold change >= 2 and FDR <= 0.05 (S2.3.p1-p2)

named_genes.Cd300e: down in E, 46% of NE, p = 0.008

final.paper_enrichment: KEGG/GO on DEGs and GSEA (S2.3.p2, S3.1.p1)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Single exercise RNA-seq experiment in the paper (S2.2.p1, S2.3.p1-p2, S3.1.p1). Pan-cancer and cell experiments use public TCGA/GTEx data or in-vitro assays and are not part of GSE272213. The paper reports mapping to 'Rnor 6.0' (rat) although the mice are BALB/c; the deposited matrix uses ENSMUSG IDs, so this is a methods-text error recorded as a discrepancy.

checks: GEO organism Mus musculus, tissue mammary cancer tissue
10 GEO samples titled E1-E5 and NE1-NE5 match the paper's 5 E + 5 NE design
matrix columns E1..E5, NE1..NE5 match GEO titles

ownership.reasoning: Data availability statement S6.p1 cites GSE272213; sample names and group sizes match S2.2.p1.

alignment.reasoning: The matrix has paired '<title>:read count' and '<title>:fpkm' columns plus annotation columns; only the read-count columns are kept and their prefix equals GEO title. grp derives from the title prefix (E = exercise, NE = non-exercise), consistent with characteristics treatment (voluntary exercise condition / without intervention).

matrix.reasoning: The kept columns are labelled 'read count'; all values are non-negative integers with no missing values and library sizes 15-23 M. The FPKM columns are dropped. The paper used StringTie FPKM with TMM normalisation (S2.3.p1); raw read counts are the appropriate input for a TMM-based count model.

candidates.reason_rejected: raw read counts for the same samples are deposited, and the paper's TMM normalisation is a count-based step

design.reasoning: Randomised two-arm intervention (S2.2.p1): E vs NE, NE as reference. All mice female so no sex split. 'Five matched pairs' (S3.1.p1) is not supported by any pairing variable and the design text describes independent random allocation, so no subject block.

candidates.reason_rejected: no pairing key in GEO or the paper; animals were randomised independently (S2.2.p1); pairing by sample number would be positional

covariance.reasoning: Independent animals, one tumour each; no batch, lane, or sex variation recorded in GEO.

paper_route.reason: paper names TMM normalisation; tool not named

deviations: Raw read counts used instead of StringTie FPKM as input; TMM computed by edgeR

method.reasoning: S2.3.p1 states TMM normalisation, the edgeR normalisation, so edgeR on raw counts is the closest reproduction. DESeq2 runs as a sensitivity analysis.

candidates.reason_rejected: paper names TMM; DESeq2 kept as sensitivity

threshold.reasoning: S2.3.p2: fold change >= 2 and FDR <= 0.05 -> BH padj <= 0.05 and |log2FC| >= 1 (inclusive). Audit: padj < 0.05 without a fold-change cutoff.

caveats: Paper says reads were mapped to Rnor 6.0 (rat) but the deposited matrix uses mouse Ensembl IDs; we use the deposited mouse matrix.
Paper's DE tool is not named; edgeR is inferred from 'TMM'.
Paper reports Cd300e p = 0.008, which is a raw p-value; it is not clear whether Cd300e passed the paper's FDR rule.

study.reasoning: Primary edgeR contrast compared with the paper's 22 DEGs and Cd300e direction (down in E).

discrepancies.data: ENSMUSG mouse gene IDs; GEO organism Mus musculus
no pairing variable; S2.2.p1 random allocation into two groups
read count and FPKM columns both deposited; read counts used

executions.reasoning: Paper's TMM-normalised two-group comparison, E vs NE.

executions.name: grp_E_vs_NE_deseq2
executions.reasoning: Method sensitivity: the paper's DE tool is not named.
